snippet.title: Devil's Roulette | Quest 3 Gameplay (No Commentary, 20 Min) – Russian Roulette Experience in VR
snippet.description:
Experience the unique world of Devil’s Roulette on Meta Quest 3!  

In this gameplay video, you’ll see the full VR process – from the intense single-player mode to the thrilling multiplayer battles. Perfect for those curious about what this game offers before diving into VR.  

📷 Recorded on: Meta Quest 3 (in-device capture)
📺 Length: 23:36
📌 Format: No commentary / Pure gameplay

In my opinion - fun VR game, especially the multiplayer mode.

⏱️ Timestamps:  
00:00 – Intro Screen  
00:15 – Entering the Game  
00:40 – First Gameplay Round  
04:00 – Second Gameplay Round
07:20 – Devil Annoyingly Laughs When You Lose
09:10 – Advanced Gameplay Round With Additional Items 
15:30 – Multiplayer Session Begins  
22:30 – Final Round and Epic Victory in Multiplayer  
19:40 – Victory Dab and Outro  / Logo

If you found this useful, subscribe for more Quest 3 gameplay videos, more yet to come: http://www.youtube.com/@mc911vrgameplays

#Quest3 #VRGameplay #DevilsRoulette #MetaQuest3
